SELECT BOOKSET_ID id,BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET
AND BOOKSET_TYPE = #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

select D.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, /* 账套代码 */ D.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, /* 账套名称 */ A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, /* 业务编号 */ C.FEE_TYPE as feeType, /* 费用类型 */
A.PRIN as prin, /* 金额 */ TO_CHAR(A.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as vdate, /* 开始日期 */ TO_CHAR(A.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as mdate /* 结束日期 */ from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A inner join BOK_DETAIL_ID B on B.BUSI_ID = A.FINPROD_ID and B.TRADE_ID = A.FINPROD_ID inner join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL C on C.TRADE_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
and C.IS_PREPAID = 'Y' inner join BOK_BOOKSET D on D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID where A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'C19'
AND D.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
and C.FEE_TYPE in
#{item}
and A.VDATE >= to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and A.MDATE <= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
ORDER BY B.BOOKSET_ID,A.VDATE DESC
